title: Choose Your Next Meaningful Goal
subtitle: Start with participation, then choose a manageable next step.
description: A useful goal connects to something you value and can be adjusted as you learn.

fields.label: What meaningful activity do you want to move toward?
Why does it matter to you?
What is one manageable step for the next seven days?
When and where will you try it?
How could you adapt the step if circumstances change?

successMessage: Goal saved. Progress comes from learning and adjusting, not executing every plan perfectly.
